thread:
Alex K: Quick sync — telemetry governance + observe scope for the next sprint. Need firm decisions on dashboards, tracing hooks, cost attribution, and error analytics launch criteria. Who can drive cone-of-work?
Maria P: I can drive dashboards + acceptance criteria. My asks: curated top-10 metrics, per-route cost, and a lightweight drilldown. Want a concrete slice we can ship in 2 weeks.
Sachin R: I’ll own tracing hooks. Proposal: two levels — full trace for enterprise beta, sampling for self-serve. Config: sample_rate_by_customer_tier (0.01 for free, 0.2 for paid, 1.0 for enterprise). Thoughts?
Olivia L: Agree split makes sense. Also: make tracing agent togglable per-route so we can enable on problem traffic without infra redeploy.
Alex K: Good. Maria — what does a 2‑week dashboard slice look like? Minimal MVP please.
Maria P: MVP dash = latency p50/p95 per-model, request count, errors by code, cost-per-route (tokens * model-rate), and a 'hotspot' panel showing top 5 routes by cost in last 1h. Filters: time range, customer-id, model.
Sachin R: For hooks: add a tiny payload spec for sampled traces: {"route","model","cost_estimate","tokens","latency_ms","error_code"}. Keep it under 2kb. We'll store traces in short retention (7d) for self-serve, 90d for enterprise.
Olivia L: Error analytics scope: cluster by signature (stack+message normalized) + enrich with model/version and prompt fingerprint. Launch acceptance: dedupe >80% of identical-signature noise, actionable grouping for SRE/PM.
Alex K: Customer ask: AcmeGames wants per-customer cost attribution and a simple export CSV. Can we include that in MVP or is that a stretch?
Maria P: We can add a CSV export endpoint that pulls the dashboard slice. Make it opt-in via feature flag. Owner: Maria.
Sachin R: One more gating item — performance SLO. Instrumentation should not add >2% p95 latency. If hooks push over that, we default to sampling-only. TelemetryBot: Deploy check — instrumentation sampling toggles validated in staging (tests: sampling on/off, trace payload size, retention enforcement).
Alex K: Launch criteria checklist (proposed): 1) Dashboard panels available and editable; 2) Tracing hooks deployed with sampling policy; 3) Cost-per-route visible and exportable; 4) Error analytics grouping hits >80% signal/noise improvement in validation set; 5) p95 latency overhead <2%; 6) Beta customers (>=2) onboarded and verified. Any objections?
Olivia L: No objections. Suggest we add acceptance for observability UX: minimal drilldown flow <=3 clicks from main panel to example trace.
Maria P: Added. Also: add telemetry governance doc: default retention/PII rules, and a template for customer opt-ins. I’ll draft.
Alex K: Great. Actions: Maria — dashboards + CSV export + gov doc (owner). Sachin — tracing hooks + sampling config (owner). Olivia — error analytics clustering + UX checks (owner). I’ll coordinate beta outreach. Target: ship alpha to 2 beta customers by EOD next sprint (thread_ts 1745123400).
Sachin R: Ack. I’ll put a PR for trace payload spec by EOD today.
Maria P: Ack — will drop dashboard wireframes in #design and a short acceptance checklist.
TelemetryBot: NOTE: New task created — OBSERVE-342: "Alpha telemetry slice + trace sampling" assigned to Alex K, Maria P, Sachin R, Olivia L.
Alex K: Thanks team — will follow up with calendar invite for a 30m triage on Monday to lock tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
